Entirely invented ExportOrders rows, generated by `python scripts/generate-fulfilment-fixture.py` from the existing invented Shopify card envelopes. No captured export, personal columns, real order numbers or business figures. Forty parcels cover both warehouses, one unmatched number, one unknown service and one postage outlier. The figures are intentionally simple for reproducible sample checks. Sample dates follow the application's fixed 30 September clock.
